expectations.E1: Every optimiser (APE, OPRO, TextGrad-style, GEPA-style) picks an instruction that beats the baseline on the test set in each of its 3 seeds.
expectations.E2: The best method's mean test gain over the baseline is at least 5 points.
expectations.E3: Overfitting: averaged over the 12 runs, the chosen instruction's train accuracy exceeds its same-source held-out accuracy by 3 to 10 points more than the baseline's own train minus held-out gap.
expectations.E4: The GEPA-style loop beats APE on mean test accuracy by at least 2 points.
expectations.E5: In the TextGrad-style runs, fewer than half of the edit steps raise train accuracy, so most steps are rejected.
expectations.E6: For at least two methods the standard deviation of test accuracy over the 3 seeds is 2 points or more.
expectations.E7: The instruction DSPy's GEPA finds, scored by our evaluator, lands within 5 points of our GEPA-style mean test accuracy.
expectations.E8: No run reaches 70% on the test set: the frozen 1.7B model, not the instruction, sets the ceiling.
